title: FNAF 2 Scream
blurb: The FNAF 2 jumpscare scream — the sequel's animatronic shriek, sharper and meaner than the original. Toy animatronics turned out to be nothing like toys, and this scream is the proof. Essential for horror edits, reaction-bait, and completing your Freddy's audio arsenal alongside the first game's scream. The night shift never gets easier.
origin: The jumpscare scream from Five Nights at Freddy's 2.
